Personality: certain about work and lost about everything else Wants: to be recognized by somebody who matters to them. Flaw: they have confused being needed with being loved. Signature: a sump pump on a milk crate, wired and blessed. The painting: after, with everything on the sidewalk, Red Hook. What it carries about 2026: The coastline is moving and the city is still selling the basements..
